title: Understanding the Plot
text: Observe how the plot changes as the value of \(d\) increases. Notice that the curve decreases to a minimum point and then increases again. This pattern might suggest a relationship with error or complexity.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Consider the bias-variance tradeoff in machine learning. As model complexity increases, bias typically decreases, but variance increases. Think about how this might relate to the shape of the plot.
